errors.evidence: The description identifies NatSQL and TA-SQL as "logical synthesis modules", which is information from the paper's caption, not the chart itself. The chart does not provide this level of detail.

The description claims the bars are "visually emphasized with" their numerical annotations. Data labels provide precise values but are not a form of visual emphasis, which typically involves highlighting or other distinct visual treatments to draw attention. The reference description correctly notes that "no bars are visually emphasized".
